neighbours.label: the piece 'an' / '-an' as a word-start fragment glued to what precedes it (live-an|imal, text-an|alyzing, auto|an|alyzer, '(an'), not the free-standing article ' an'
fire: The clinic runs a small-animal ward on the ground floor.
Their data-analysis team works in the basement.
The patient was moved to the post-anesthesia unit.
The survey was strictly non-anonymous, which annoyed people.
Years of self-analysis had made him tired of himself.
A wild-animal park opened outside the town last summer.
His reply (an obvious dodge) satisfied nobody.
The lab ordered a new bioanalyzer for the RNA samples.
quiet: The clinic runs an animal ward on the ground floor.
Their analysis team works in the basement.
The patient was given an anesthetic before the operation.
The survey was an anonymous one, which pleased people.
Years of analysis had made him tired of himself.
An animal park opened outside the town last summer.
His reply was an obvious dodge and satisfied nobody.
The lab ordered an analyzer for the RNA samples.
